journal_lines: §lSlime§l in the low passage. Messy work. Got it done.
Big one split into four. Four split into more. Kept going.
§oSmelled like wet stone and nothing else.§o Heard it bouncing before I saw it.
Cleared the big one. The small ones took longer.
Stuck to my paw for a moment. Shook it off. Kept at it.
§lSlime§l under a low ceiling, six of them stacked in the damp. Worked through from the outside.
Each one that fell made two more. Didn't let that bother me.
Green and slow. Stubborn. Eventually gone.
§oThey bounce when they move. You can hear them well before they arrive.§o Used the time.
§cSlid into a cluster of the small ones. Four-legged scramble.§o Got clear. Cleared them.
Took the big one first. Then the smaller split-offs. Then the smaller ones after that.
Bounced off the wall and right at me. Dealt with it mid-air.
